title: Successor-variable polynomial Tor bound
statement: Let A be any commutative ring, n and d natural numbers, R = MvPolynomial (Fin n) A and S = MvPolynomial (Fin (n+1)) A, and let ρ : R → S be the coefficient inclusion rename Fin.castSucc. For every S-module M, suppose Tor_i^R(M restricted along ρ, N) = 0 for every R-module N and every i > d [def-weil-pbc-tor-modules]. Then Tor_i^S(M, N) = 0 for every S-module N and i > d+1. No finiteness, Noetherianity or domain assumption is required; n=0, d=0, the zero ring and zero modules are included.

source.document: C. Weibel, An Introduction to Homological Algebra
source.place: Theorem 4.3.7, pp. 101–102, its canonical exact-sequence argument applied to Tor; https://math.mit.edu/~hrm/palestine/weibel/04-homological_dimension.pdf

proof.text: Apply exists_polynomial_induced_presentation to obtain a short exact sequence E → E → M, where E=Ext_ρ(Res_ρ M).

Prove ρ flat by rotating variables and composing with finSuccEquiv: the coefficient inclusion becomes Polynomial.C. Polynomial rings are free over their coefficient ring; RingHom.flat_algebraMap_iff and RingHom.Flat.comp_iff_of_bijective_left transfer flatness back.

For every j>d apply nonempty_flat_scalar_extension_tor_iso to L=Res_ρ M and N. The hypothesis hTor kills Tor_j^R(L,Res_ρ N). Transport zero across the comparison isomorphism. ModuleCat.isZero_iff_subsingleton reflects zero through restriction, so Tor_j^S(E,N)=0.

Prove the private tor_isZero_of_shortExact helper: reuse resolutionSES from import all Sheaf.Paper.TorLongExactFirstVariable, the projective-resolution packaging of the cited split free horseshoe statement. Tensor its degreewise splittings with N to get a short exact sequence of complexes. The resolution computation isomorphisms turn the two assumed Tor zero objects into homology zero objects. Mathlib ShortComplex.ShortExact.mono_δ makes the connecting map from H_(j+1)(P_M tensor N) into H_j(P_E tensor N) mono; IsZero.of_mono then kills its source. Transport back with isoLeftDerivedObj.

For i>d+1 write i=j+1 using Nat.exists_eq_succ_of_ne_zero. Arithmetic gives j>d and j+1>d. Apply the helper to E → E → M with the two zero objects from step 3. This proves the original statement without changing any binder or adding any hole.

lean.statement:
theorem polynomial_successor_tor_bound
    {A : Type u} [CommRing A]
    (n : ℕ) (M : ModuleCat.{u} (MvPolynomial (Fin (n + 1)) A)) (d : ℕ)
    (hTor : ∀ N : ModuleCat.{u} (MvPolynomial (Fin n) A), ∀ i : ℕ, d < i →
      IsZero (((Tor' (ModuleCat.{u} (MvPolynomial (Fin n) A)) i).obj
        ((restrictScalars (MvPolynomial.rename Fin.castSucc).toRingHom).obj M)).obj N)) :
    ∀ N : ModuleCat.{u} (MvPolynomial (Fin (n + 1)) A), ∀ i : ℕ, d + 1 < i →
      IsZero (((Tor' (ModuleCat.{u} (MvPolynomial (Fin (n + 1)) A)) i).obj M).obj N)
